printed.label: intro
printed.text: Here is a new kind of cross-word puzzle for FUN'S puzzle experts to wrestle with. It is a contribution from W. G. H. Tiedemann of Third avenue, New York City, who very naturally suggests that any one who attempts to solve it is going to have a very interesting half hour. However, that remains to be determined when you try the puzzle yourself. The puzzle editor has taken the liberty to change several words and definitions in Mr. Tiedemann's original puzzle so that he, too, will have an interesting time of solving his own puzzle. Fill in the small squares with words corresponding to the list of clues and definitions given herewith. One letter only is to be placed in such square. The solution to this puzzle will be given in next week's FUN.
